context: Beyond a few macroeconomic studies on the  impacts  of  standards, 4   the  evidence  from microeconomic studies  finds  positive  returns  to adopting standards. Productivity gains range from 2.4 percent to 17.6 percent in Central America 5 and are about 4.5 percent in China, with smaller but statistically significant effects in Southeast Asia. 6 Firms  that  adopt  standards  grow  faster,  export more, and have better management systems (refer to table 4.1). Only a couple of studies examining the  effects  of  adopting  private  standards  find  a negative impact on profitability when additional revenue  from  the  resulting  price  premium  does not compensate for the costs of compliance with the standards.
